verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹੋਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਅਮਰ ਅਮਰਿ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur hoaa satigurahu acharaj amar amar varataiaa|

en.bdb: From the true Guru (Angad Dev) becoming the truthful Guru, Amar

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਟਿਕਾ ਸੋ ਬੈਹਣਾ ਸੋਈ ਸਚਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: so Tikaa so baihanaa soiee sachaa hukam chalaiaa|

en.bdb: Has enacted a wondrous feat. The same light, the same seat and the same will of Lord is being spread by him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਖੋਲਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: khol khajaanaa sabadh dhaa saadhasa(n)gat sach mel milaiaa|

en.bdb: He has opened up the storehouse of word and has made the truth manifest through the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਚੇਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਲੈ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur chelaa paravaan kar chaar varan lai pairee paiaa|

en.bdb: Making the disciple authentic, the Guru has put all the four varnas at his feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh ik dhiaaieeaai dhuramat dhoojaa bhaau miTaiaa|

en.bdb: Now all becoming gurmukhs adore the one Lord and evil wisdom and duality have been wiped out of them.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਾ ਧਰਮ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: kulaa dharam gursikh sabh maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Now the duty of the family and the teaching of the Guru is that one should be detacthed while living amidst maya
The perfect Guru has created the perfect grandeur.
